title: The alliance with the Mamlūks, lost in the autumn of 1366, is renewed. Cairo stands with Gharnāṭa again

data.lapsed: between 2 October and 6 November 1366, most likely with the console fix

title: Fās takes up its old claim again: the casus belli to demand Andalusī submission, the same one it used in 1360, is Morocco's against Granada until 1382

Queen Maria of Portugal dies of a sudden illness, and her son Jerónimo, king of Castile since his father Alfonso fell on the march in March 1366, inherits her crown. Qashtāla and al-Burtughāl pass under one king. The two realms keep their own governments (federal status, each crown's own succession), but the frontier from the Tagus to the hills of Mursiyya now answers to one court

data.ruler: Jerónimo of Castile (born 1343), son of Alfonso of Castile and Maria of Portugal
data.died: Maria of Portugal (born 1313; queen from 29 January 1342)
data.before: a marriage union of the two crowns, Alfonso and Maria, from 29 January 1342 until Alfonso's death on 29 March 1366
